hook.say: Famous landmarks, but which country are they in? Five questions, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: In which country is the Sagrada Família?
questions.say: In which country is the Sagrada Familia church?
questions.fact: Work on the Barcelona church began in 1882 and it is still not finished.
questions.sayAnswer: Spain! Work on this church in Barcelona began in 1882, and it is still not finished.

questions.q: In which country are the Maya ruins of Chichén Itzá?
questions.say: In which country are the Maya ruins of Chee-chen Eet-sah?
questions.fact: Its famous step pyramid, El Castillo, is about 30 meters high.
questions.sayAnswer: Mexico! The famous step pyramid there, El Castillo, is about 30 meters high.

questions.q: In which country is the rock-carved city of Petra?
questions.fact: Petra is called the Rose City, after the sandstone it is carved from.
questions.sayAnswer: Jordan! Petra is called the Rose City, after the color of the sandstone it is carved from.

questions.q: In which country is the temple of Angkor Wat?
questions.fact: Angkor Wat is the world's largest religious structure.
questions.sayAnswer: Cambodia! Angkor Wat is the largest religious structure in the world, and it even appears on Cambodia's flag.

questions.q: Easter Island and its giant stone heads belong to which country?
questions.fact: The island has nearly 900 statues and lies about 3,500 km off Chile.
questions.sayAnswer: Chile! The island has nearly 900 statues, and lies about 3,500 kilometers off the coast of Chile.
